summary: Implemented reusable competition lifecycle and AI contender seeding for the web console: a versioned current/archive catalog, catalog-driven SST artifact uploads, immutable DynamoDB policy-score records with exact replay validation, persisted research URLs, archived leaderboard selection, and preview-first list/start/activate/archive/seed commands. The standard seed set includes all registered public-information TypeScript contenders, including D4. No production deploy or DynamoDB write was performed because the live site must first understand policy-score records and the shared dirty worktree contains unrelated changes.
validationPerformed: npm test --prefix web: 20 competition and browser-solver parity tests passed
npm run build --prefix web: Next.js webpack production build passed
npm run competition -- seed --stage production --profile personal-deploy: nine-policy dry run completed, including D4, with exact independent replay validation and no illegal moves
npm run competition -- start preview: immutable manifest and archive/current catalog update rendered without writing files
SST production diff: catalog-driven configuration and OpenNext bundle completed without deployment
Empty-checkout fixture with no web/data, empty research/results, and no web/content/log: root, leaderboard, research, and log routes returned HTTP 200
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.

The seeded expectimax-d4 entry is the existing TypeScript D4 playground policy, not a source-identical port of approaches/fair-expectimax/reference/fair-only-depth4.cpp; the UI and policy description disclose that boundary.
All competition scores are single scripted-game playground results and are never research-tier evidence.
Production DynamoDB was intentionally left unchanged until the corresponding web code is deployed; the current deployed mapper would otherwise misclassify policy-score records as humans.
The shared worktree contains unrelated uncommitted changes, so deploying it would exceed this task's safe scope.
make research-validate remains blocked by 26 pre-existing references to locally absent ignored run artifacts.
